title: Merge pricing check into provider types workflow, with PR auto-fix
description:
## Summary

Two things were manual and easy to forget: syncing `chatlas/data/prices.json` from Ellmer, and remembering to run `make update-types` when provider SDKs change. This folds pricing sync into the same tooling as the provider-types check, and makes both self-healing on PRs.

- Added `make update-pricing`, which fetches Ellmer's `data-raw/prices.json` directly (no local Ellmer checkout needed) — so there's now a single documented command instead of an ad hoc copy step.
- Merged `check-update-types.yml` and `update-pricing.yml` into one "Check Provider Types & Pricing" workflow that runs both `make update-types` and `make update-pricing` and checks for drift together.
- When drift is found on a PR from a branch in this repo (not a fork), the workflow now commits and pushes the fix directly to the PR branch instead of just failing — the check still reports failure on that run (so the PR's checks history shows something was out of date), and the push triggers a fresh run that goes green once the fix lands. Fork PRs, direct pushes, and manual/`release` runs keep today's fail-with-diff-and-instructions behavior, since GitHub's default token can't push to fork branches.

## Test plan

- [x] `make update-pricing` run locally — produces valid JSON, superset of previously in-progress manual pricing edits
- [x] `uv run pytest tests/test_tokens.py::test_prices_json_validates_against_typeddict -v` passes against the updated pricing data
- [x] New workflow YAML validated with `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(...)"`
- [ ] Confirm the merged workflow runs successfully on this PR (types/pricing already in sync, so it should pass without triggering the autofix path)
